Physical inputs, framebuffer/evdev rotation, sensor-follow, sleep/wake, e-ink behavior, performance and genuine live-reader leases remain outside screenshot qualification.
G30 landscape/swipe and neutral-tap/viewport behavior belong to the separate assigned lane. This portrait review creates no G30 closure.
